actionConfiguration.body:
select
    c.id::text as value,

    case
        when nullif(trim(c.email), '') is not null then
            c.contact_name || ' — ' || c.email

        when nullif(trim(c.mobile), '') is not null then
            c.contact_name || ' — ' || c.mobile

        when nullif(trim(c.phone), '') is not null then
            c.contact_name || ' — ' || c.phone

        when nullif(trim(c.title), '') is not null then
            c.contact_name || ' — ' || c.title

        else
            c.contact_name
    end as label,

    c.contact_name,
    c.title,
    c.phone,
    c.mobile,
    c.email,
    c.notes,
    c.active,
    c.deleted,

    exists (
        select 1
        from public.customer_contact_links ccl
        where ccl.client_id = c.client_id
          and ccl.contact_id = c.id
          and ccl.customer_id =
              nullif(
                  {{ Number(selEvtCustomer.selectedOptionValue || 0) }},
                  0
              )
          and ccl.active = true
    ) as linked_to_selected_customer

from public.vw_contacts c

where c.client_id =
      '{{ appsmith.store.current_client_id }}'::uuid

  and c.active = true
  and coalesce(c.deleted, false) = false

order by
    linked_to_selected_customer desc,
    lower(c.contact_name),
    lower(coalesce(c.email, '')),
    c.id;
